Thanks again for the quick chat last week. Avery Events runs a compact partner roadshow (typically 250–400 attendees live) and we think Redwood would be a great fit as a co-host. High-level concept:

We have a standard MDF framework we typically work with — we cover 40% of hard costs and ask partners to cover the remainder OR we can work on a split by deliverable (lead list rental, paid promo, onsite staff). Attached is our standard MDF outline (Avery-MDF-Terms-v1.pdf).

3) Any excluded weeks in Sept–Nov?

We can be flexible on dates but prefer Sept 28–Oct 22 window. If helpful I can propose exact dates once I hear staffing/marketing cadence.
